name: Misty Pine Refuge
summary: In central Dun Morogh, the Argent Dawn keeps a small outpost at Misty Pine Refuge.

sections.title: Shelter in the Snow
sections.body: Misty Pine Refuge is an unassuming Argent Dawn outpost among Dun Morogh's windswept hills. Ironforge mountaineers patrol the crags nearby. Father Gavin, the order's lone agent here, keeps a quiet hearth amid bitter cold and danger on the mountain roads.

faq.answer: The Argent Dawn keeps a small outpost at Misty Pine Refuge in central Dun Morogh. Father Gavin is the order's only agent there.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn here in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn chiefly watches the undead menace in the north. Agents such as Father Gavin also keep watch in quieter corners of Alliance lands.
Father Gavin, an Argent Dawn agent, is the order's only member stationed at Misty Pine Refuge.

angles.text: As a priest, you can see Father Gavin's humble post as an example of the Light's service through quiet vigilance, far from the battlefields.
